name: security-audit-entry-mapper
description: Given a repository URL or local path, automatically maps all entry points (HTTP routes, gRPC definitions, CLI parsers, webhook handlers, MCP tool definitions) and outputs a prioritized audit target list ordered by trust boundary crossing risk.
author: OpenCode Security Research Agent
trigger: when starting a new codebase audit

inputs.repository_url: string — git URL or local path to target repo
inputs.goal: string — Confidentiality | Integrity | Availability | ATO | RCE

outputs: entry_point_map.json — structured list of sources with metadata
sink_inventory.json — dangerous function calls with file locations
trust_boundary_diagram.md — Mermaid diagram of component trust relationships
steps: 3. Execute framework-specific router extraction (Express app._router.stack, FastAPI app.routes, Rails routes.rb, Django urls.py)
4. Enumerate non-HTTP surfaces: gRPC .proto files, CLI parsers, webhook handlers, file uploads, MQ consumers, cron inputs, MCP tool definitions, agent skill manifests
5. Run Semgrep with custom sink-detection rules (run_semgrep MCP tool)
6. Run CodeQL for cross-function taint paths (run_codeql MCP tool)
7. Generate trust boundary diagram from component analysis
8. Score each entry point by: trust_crossing x sink_proximity x auth_check_distance
